description:
Returns the subscription's current customer-facing page link without rotating it, so a link already in the customer's hands keeps working.

The create response has no `page_url`. Call this endpoint at any time after creation, with no need to wait for the first payment, and send the link to your customer yourself: Ottu sends the customer no email at signup and does not resend links. To re-send a link that should keep working, read it here instead of regenerating it.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: AutoPay subscription identifier returned by subscription creation.

page_token.description: The signed token that identifies the subscription on the self-service page. Use it on its own only if you build the customer-facing URL yourself; otherwise hand out `page_url`.

page_url.description:
The complete link to hand to the customer. Ottu builds it from your primary domain, the subscription's language and `page_token`.

Anyone holding this link can act on the subscription, so treat it as a credential and deliver it only to the subscription's own customer. See [Customer Self-Service Page](/developers/payments/autopay/#customer-self-service-page).

schema.description: The customer's current self-service link. Reading it never changes it, so a link the customer already has keeps working.

responses.description: The API key is missing or invalid. Send your private API key as `Authorization: Api-Key <your key>`.
No subscription with this id exists on your account. Do not retry.
Payments are paused on your Ottu account (`code: service_paused`), so the subscription endpoints are unavailable. Retry once payments are resumed.
The subscription service is unavailable. Retry with backoff.
The subscription service timed out. Nothing was changed, so the request is safe to retry.
